topic: 定语从句与关系代词/关系副词的运用 (Relative Clauses)
teaching_notes: 嗨，同学们！今天我们来学习英语里的“描述高手”——定语从句（Relative Clauses）。当我们要对一个名词进行详细补充说明时，可以使用关系词来连接：who 指人，which 指物，that 既可指人也可指物，whose 表示“谁的”，而 where 和 when 则分别用来补充地点和时间信息。需要提醒大家的是：whose 后面必须紧跟被拥有的名词，且在介词后面指人时通常要用 whom 哦！例如：The girl who won the prize is my sister.（得奖的那个女孩是我的妹妹。）This is the library where I read books every Saturday.（这就是我每周六看书的图书馆。）

questions.question: The boy _______ won the chess tournament is a Grade 5 student.
questions.explanation: 先行词是人（The boy），且在从句中担当主语，因此使用关系代词 who。

questions.question: Look at the cute puppy _______ tail is wagging so fast!
questions.explanation: 从句中 tail（尾巴）属于前面的小狗（puppy），表示所属关系“小狗的”，因此用 whose。

questions.question: The storybook _______ you lent me yesterday is super interesting.
questions.explanation: 先行词是物品（The storybook），在从句中作宾语，应用关系代词 which 或 that。

questions.question: This is the science museum _______ we visited our favorite space exhibit.
questions.explanation: 先行词是地点（the science museum），在从句中作地点状语（即 we visited the exhibit in the museum），因此用关系副词 where。

questions.question: Mrs. Green is the teacher _______ organized the international food fair.
questions.explanation: 先行词是人（the teacher），在从句中作主语，用关系代词 who。

questions.question: I still remember the day _______ our team won the football championship.
questions.explanation: 先行词是具体时间（the day），在从句中作时间状语（即 won the championship on that day），因此用关系副词 when。

questions.question: The artist _______ paintings are displayed in the art gallery lives nearby.
questions.explanation: 从句中的 paintings（画作）属于这位艺术家（The artist），表示所属关系“艺术家的”，因此填 whose。

questions.question: Is there any special reason _______ he missed the school bus this morning?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 reason（原因），在从句中作原因状语，使用关系副词 why。

questions.question: This is the best computer software _______ can help us learn coding.
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级 the best 修饰时，关系代词只能用 that 而不用 which。

questions.question: The girl to _______ you were speaking at the party is my cousin.
questions.explanation: 关系代词紧跟在介词 to 后面且指代人（The girl）时，必须使用宾格形式 whom。

questions.question: Pizza is a delicious dish _______ originated in Italy many years ago.
questions.explanation: 先行词是食物（a delicious dish），在从句中作主语，应用关系代词 which 或 that。

questions.question: The quiet town _______ my grandparents live has lots of green trees.
questions.explanation: 先行词是地点（The quiet town），从句完整且表地点状语（live in the town），故用 where。

questions.question: Do you know the student _______ dad built a real working robot?
questions.explanation: 从句中的 dad（爸爸）与先行词 the student 是所属关系（学生的爸爸），应填 whose。

questions.question: This is all _______ I can tell you about the secret science project.
questions.explanation: 当先行词是不定代词 all 时，引导定语从句的关系代词必须用 that。

questions.question: The musician _______ played the violin so beautifully was applauded by everyone.
questions.explanation: 先行词是人（The musician），在从句中担任主语，因此选择 who。

questions.question: The building _______ roof was painted bright yellow is our new cafeteria.
questions.explanation: roof（屋顶）属于 the building（建筑物的屋顶），关系代词 whose 既可用于人也可用于物表示所属关系。

questions.question: Autumn is the season _______ leaves turn red and yellow in the forest.
questions.explanation: 先行词是时间名词 the season，在从句中表示时间状语，故用 when。

questions.question: The pencil case _______ Lily bought last weekend matches her school bag.
questions.explanation: 先行词是物品（The pencil case），从句中缺少宾语，因此用 which 或 that。

questions.question: The club in _______ we practice badminton after school has great coaches.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后面直接接关系代词指物时，只能用 which，不能用 that 或 where。

questions.question: The scientist _______ discovered the ancient dinosaur fossils gave a lecture.
questions.explanation: 先行词是人（The scientist），在从句中充当主语，故使用 who。

questions.question: The house _______ my uncle built 20 years ago still looks very modern.
questions.explanation: 注意！从句中 built 缺少宾语（built the house），虽然先行词是建筑物，但作宾语时要用关系代词 which/that，而不是 where。

questions.question: The boy with _______ Sam usually shares his snacks is very kind.
questions.explanation: 在介词 with 后面指代人（The boy），必须使用宾格关系代词 whom。

questions.question: The bakery _______ sells the tastiest blueberry muffins is near our school.
questions.explanation: 先行词虽然是地点（The bakery），但在从句中充当主语（sells 的主语），因此用关系代词 which 而非关系副词 where。

questions.question: 2025 was the year _______ our school established the new swimming team.
questions.explanation: 先行词是年份（the year），从句成分完整且表达“在这一年”，因此用关系副词 when。

questions.question: The digital camera with _______ Ben took these amazing photos is quite expensive.
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指代物品（camera），关系代词只能用 which。

questions.question: The children _______ parents attend the PTA meeting are waiting in the library.
questions.explanation: parents（父母）属于 The children（孩子们），表所属关系“孩子们的父母”，用 whose。

questions.question: Beijing is the vibrant city _______ the 2008 Olympic Games took place.
questions.explanation: 先行词是地点（the vibrant city），从句中 took place 在该地点举行，表示地点状语，故用 where。

questions.question: The poster _______ won first place in the art contest was painted by Mia.
questions.explanation: 先行词是物品（The poster），在从句中担当主语，选择 which 或 that。

questions.question: My uncle David, _______ works as a pilot for an international airline, visits us often.
questions.explanation: 在非限制性定语从句中（有逗号隔开），指代人且作主语时只能用 who，不能用 that。

questions.question: This smart gadget is the only thing _______ can solve our technical problem.
questions.explanation: 当先行词受到 the only（唯一的）修饰时，引导定语从句的关系代词必须使用 that。
